title: Sides and Corners
short: Count the sides and corners of a shape.

blocks.html: Shapes have sides and corners. A side is a straight edge. A corner is where two sides meet. Let’s count them!

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Touch each gold dot. How many corners?

blocks.html: A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners. Squares and rectangles have 4 of each.

blocks.title: A square’s corners
blocks.q: How many corners does a square have?

blocks.html: For the grown-up: Run a finger along the edges of a book and count the sides. Tap each corner of a napkin. Make shapes with play dough and poke a finger in each corner. Keep screen time short: two or three problems, then play.

items: Try it at home: Count corners on a book.
Walk around a rug and count its sides.
Make shapes with sticks and count them.
